note: N has ONE definition: quantities.N. The former top-level `census` block (N=32000, an addrman ADDRESS sample) was removed on 2026-09-17 — it was a stale duplicate that naive parsers read instead of quantities.N (it broke the C leg of research/reproduce/cross_check.sh). Provenance now lives on quantities.N.captured_at / census_date.

C.name: annual node operating cost
C.note: Python model exact component sum is 924.35; 925 is the pinned canonical value.

C_insc.name: annual node operating cost (python-exact component sum)
C_insc.canonicalSource: 166.67 + 600 + 157.68 (component sum); C=925 is the pinned rounded canonical
C_insc.note: Used ONLY by the marginal inscription branch so cb_insc and L_insc reproduce the python model's historic values exactly.

N.name: full-node replication factor (validating nodes bearing storage cost)
N.canonicalSource: MEASURED reachable-node count (validating; a floor): 26,586 (btcnodes reachable-node crawl, 2026-09-16; data/node_census_series.json). Validating nodes bear the storage cost; miners (a few dozen pools) are separate fee recipients and are not counted here. Non-listening/private nodes are not remotely observable, so this is a measured LOWER bound on validating nodes — a larger N would lower the SCCR.
N.note: Re-based 2026-09-17 from the previous 32,000 (an addrman ADDRESS sample at the request ceiling, never a node count) to the measured reachable-node count (validating; a floor). SCCR is inverse-linear in N, so the headline rises by 32000/26586 = 1.2036x (+20.4%). N is a lower bound (non-listening nodes are invisible); the true validating set is larger, which would lower the SCCR. See /research/verification-population.

cb.name: cost per byte per year (block-average, CANONICAL)
cb.note: Horizon-free by design. T enters ONLY via L. Replaces methodology.json v1.0.0's /T-bugged formula.

cb_insc.name: cost per byte per year (marginal inscription attribution)
cb_insc.note: Secondary attribution for the inscription-externality branch. cb_insc/cb = 164.25x ≈ B_all_yr/B_insc_yr = 164.36x — the reconciliation table's denominator gap (164x).

L.name: lifetime storage cost per node, one average block

L_net.name: lifetime network storage cost, one average block
L_net.note: DERIVED from quantities.N (single source of truth): L_net = L*N = 0.175869*26586 = 4675.653 USD/block. The previous 5627.808 was the N=32,000 value and contradicted quantities.N=26586 (consumers trusting it computed SCCR ~17% low). integrity_audit.py asserts this on every run.

SCCR.name: storage cost coverage ratio
SCCR.value: band over the capture log; value is inverse-linear in N and the live reading is in data/sccr.json (single writer). N = 26586 measured reachable nodes (validating; a floor) (lower bound).
SCCR.note: Computed as fee_USD / L_net with L_net derived from quantities.N=26586. Never hardcode a point value here; read data/sccr.json.

cost_per_gb.name: retail bandwidth cost assumption
cost_per_gb.canonicalSource: research/pruning_externality_analysis.md ('typical bandwidth costs ~$0.05/GB'); cross-check: AWS S3 egress ~$0.09/GB, Hetzner ~$0.011/GB (1TB included), consumer flat-rate ~ unmetered - $0.05/GB is a mid-range retail proxy for MARGINAL propagation cost, NOT a typical node bill.
cost_per_gb.note: LEG 2 (bandwidth) v1 - analytical bound, not a measurement. See working-paper.md 5.5.

bw_GB_yr.name: total block bytes per year (GB)
bw_GB_yr.note: 7.8894e10 bytes/yr / 1e9 = 78.894 GB/yr - every full node (pruned or archival) must download this.

bw_cost_per_year_node.name: marginal full-chain bandwidth propagation cost per node per year
bw_cost_per_year_node.note: LEG 2 v1 bound: 78.894 GB/yr x $0.05/GB = $3.94/yr/node. Marginal cost of propagating one more block to one more node (full chain). Real node bills are mostly flat-rate/unmetered, so this is an upper-bound economic proxy, not a measured bill.

bw_cost_per_year_net.name: marginal full-chain bandwidth propagation cost, network (N nodes)
bw_cost_per_year_net.note: DERIVED from quantities.N: bw_node*N = 3.9447*26586 = 104873.8 USD/yr. Previous 126230.4 was the N=32,000 value.

bw_insc_incr_node.name: marginal inscription-incremental bandwidth cost per node per year
bw_insc_incr_node.note: LEG 2 v1: 480 MB/yr of inscription data x $0.05/GB = $0.024/yr/node - reconciles pruning_externality_analysis.md '~$0.02/yr incremental' at 3 sig figs.

bandwidth leg v1 = analytical marginal-propagation bound (cost_per_gb=$0.05/GB retail proxy; real node bills mostly flat-rate) - not a measurement
